text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Twinkle Star Climax" came to an end 
amidst tremendous fanfare and fervor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The entire crowd erupts in praise at the 
very moment <chrname> became the 'Strongest'!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Such incredible excitement. Everyone is 
praising the two of them...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to ask! How does it feel to know 
that your partner has become the 
'strongest'!
choice_data_list:
...Even if I'm the only spectator in the 
crowd,

...Even if I'm the only spectator in the 
crowd,

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list:
I can say with certainty that my Umamusume 
is the "strongest".

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Um, but... You are being praised by this 
many spectators, you know?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"To be so blessed, so recognized... and 
precisely because your partner is the 
'strongest' Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I also think... she's the fastest, but...
choice_data_list:
You didn't even finish what you were 
trying to say, did you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? N-Not at all. The Twinkle Star Climax 
was a huge success, and—
choice_data_list:
You believe in the "strongest" within 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: The "strongest" inside me...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ecchan, you're so slooow! I'm gonna go on 
ahead, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: W-Wait...!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yay! I win!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: ...The truth is...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If she had run in this race, she might 
have scored the most points. That's just 
what crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Even though the other 'strongest' was 
decided. Even though she should've been 
hailed by the massive crowd... Deep down, 
I wanted her to win."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ah, today's race was seriously the best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of race we'll get to 
see next. I'm sure new challengers will 
step up and all, too...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, can't wait! I hope that girl I'm 
rooting for runs next time too~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
If I could watch from the stands the 
moment she becomes the "strongest"... It'd 
feel just like a dream, I'm sure~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: A dream...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps my dream has actually been 
continuing this entire time.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the day I failed to take first 
place in a footrace, I feel like I've 
constantly been chasing after her 
back—chasing after that dream.
choice_data_list:
Maybe there are as many kinds of 
'strongest' as there are dreams

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. The dreams people pin on the 
backs of Umamusume, each and every one...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, on this day and this day 
alone! Does the word 'strongest' not exist 
for one single Umamusume?!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer <username>! Could we get a comment 
from you, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, <chrname> became the "strongest" Umamusume 
in both name and reality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The proof of her strength is always 
sparkling with a blinding brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... even if there were no trophies. 
Even if there were no spectators at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That she is the "strongest"— This dream 
continues to believe so, forever and 
always.
